name: SURF 4850 Level — LBNF/DUNE far detector caverns
notes: Coordinates unresolved to detector precision; see the coordinates note.

summary.plain: Caverns nearly a mile underground at the Sanford laboratory, excavated to hold the huge liquid-argon detectors of the DUNE experiment.
summary.technical: LBNF far-site campus on the 4850-foot level of SURF: two detector caverns and a central utility cavern, about 1500 m of rock (4300 m.w.e.) overburden, hosting the DUNE far detector modules.
